name: watch-navigator-watch
description: Huawei Lite Wearable turn-by-turn navigation application (Watch GT5)

scripts.validate: tsc && node -e "import fs from 'fs'; const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('entry/src/main/config.json', 'utf8')); if (!config.module.deviceType.includes('liteWearable')) throw new Error('Invalid deviceType'); if (!config.module.reqPermissions?.some((p) => p.name === 'ohos.permission.VIBRATE')) throw new Error('Missing ohos.permission.VIBRATE permission'); if (!fs.existsSync('entry/src/main/resources/base/media/icon.png')) throw new Error('Missing icon.png'); console.log('Lite Wearable TypeScript build & config valid');"
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run validate

author: hungify
